planSlice: 7M pre-AC1032 embedded ATTRIB/ATTDEF MTEXT safe refusal
scope: Prevent silent loss when a pre-R2018 DXF target cannot represent R2018 embedded MTEXT attached to ATTRIB or ATTDEF.

behavior: writeAttributeR2018Features refuses embedded MTEXT on DXF targets older than AC1032 before writing the attribute record body.
The existing leftOut diagnostic reports one multiline attribute (not in this DXF version) omission.
Failed conversion preserves a pre-existing destination; retry through the same writer succeeds after removing embedded MTEXT.
coverage: ATTRIB and ATTDEF tested as separate attempts because writer errors are sticky within an attempt
Diagnostic count, record refusal, destination preservation, same-writer retry, and normal record emission after removing unsupported content
